title: OHCHR report on detention in the context of Gaza hostilities
summary: OHCHR documented detention-related violations affecting Palestinians and abuses of Israeli hostages between 7 October 2023 and 30 June 2024.
claim: OHCHR reported that thousands of Palestinians had been taken into custody since 7 October 2023, many arbitrarily and in secret and in some cases subjected to treatment that may amount to torture; it also stated that Palestinian armed groups' hostage-taking and treatment of hostages entailed violations of international humanitarian and human rights law.
legal_characterization: OHCHR findings and documented concerns regarding arbitrary detention, torture or other ill-treatment, enforced disappearance, hostage-taking, and abuse; not a court judgment.
source_organization: Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights
source_title: Detention in the context of the escalation of hostilities in Gaza (7 October 2023 - 30 June 2024)
source_quote: Thousands of Palestinians have been taken into custody, mostly men, but also women and children
verification_notes: Verified against the report's executive summary, scope, and methodology. The report covers 7 October 2023 to 30 June 2024 and says access restrictions limited OHCHR verification. This record preserves the report's qualified phrase ‘may amount to torture’ and includes its findings concerning both Palestinian detainees and Israeli hostages.
